annotations.title: Crisis lines for a country (first, before anything else)

description: Return the emergency number and crisis hotlines (suicide, text, domestic violence, child help) for one country from the verified dataset the app ships for 53 countries, with source and date checked. Call this FIRST whenever a person speaks of harming themselves or someone else, or is in danger ("I want to die", "my friend is suicidal", "he hits me"), before any Scripture or other tool; for non-urgent support use find_help_for_my_need or someone_to_talk_to on /me. Pass the person's country; if unknown, ask them, since the tool never defaults to one country's number. Matching is strict (ISO code, exact name, known alias); an unheld country returns country null, the general emergency rule (112, 911, 999) and the list of countries held. Static dataset; no network call. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

country.description: The person's country: name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("Nigeria", "GB", "Brazil", "USA"). Omit only to get the list of countries held.

name: crisis_resources

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

countries_held.description: When country is null: every country held, "Name (CODE)".

country.description: The country matched (ISO code and name), or null when not held.

crisis_line.description: National suicide or crisis line (name, number, hours, url when known), or null.

emergency.description: Emergency numbers to dial; empty when the country is not held.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

rule.description: How to use the result: give the number first and plainly, stay with the person.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

verified_at.description: Date the numbers were last checked.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.
